Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase. The Pakistan players make their way out to the middle. Vikramjit Singh and Max O'Dowd are the openers for the Netherlands. Haris Rauf will begin proceedings with the new ball.
... RUN CHASE ...
Right then, it's a big ask from the Dutch batters to scale down this target against Pakistan's well-oiled bowling unit. Let's see how they approach the chase. Do join us in a short while to find out.

The Netherlands still have a lot of work to be done with their catching and death bowling if they are to compete at the highest level. Bas de Leede was the pick of the bowlers, taking 2 wickets for 42 in his full quota of 10 overs. There were no wickets for the spinners with Logan van Beek taking two and Vivian Kingma chipping in with one. They all were very expensive though.

The Dutch bowled really well, to begin with, and were helped by Pakistan’s defensive approach. They got a wicket early after which they had to toil hard to get a breakthrough. They started leaking runs as the batters got more settled and the game seemed to be creeping away from them. At one stage, after the 20th over, Pakistan shifted gears and hammered 89 runs from the next 10 and shell-shocked the hosts. Vivian Kingma dropped Fakhar Zaman on 43 and that proved to be quite costly. However, the hosts came back strongly dismissing Babar Azam and then getting the centurion run out with some real good fielding. They kept chipping away at the wickets after that and did not allow Pakistan to go berserk towards the end.

The visitors started really watchfully as they so often have done, looking to set a solid platform and accelerate later. They lost Imam-ul-Haq early but his opening partner Fakhar Zaman motored along living a charmed life. He put on a 168-run partnership with his skipper Babar Azam to give Pakistan a great start. Fakhar reached his century and the base was set to accelerate in the last 15 overs. The set batters though departed in quick succession and Mohammad Rizwan did not last at the wicket for long. Agha Salman and Shadab Khan played useful cameos to push Pakistan just over the 300-run mark with the latter scoring 48 off just 28 balls. The visitors will probably be able to defend this but would have been hoping for a few more runs on the board.

As mentioned earlier, at one point it looked like Pakistan would get to 350 but the Netherlands did really well to restrict them to 314. Pakistan will feel that they could have done much better with the start they had but will feel it is probably still enough to win them this game. The Dutchmen fought well with the ball against a well-equipped batting unit and now it is up to the batters to try and chase down this target against a good bowling line-up.

Excellent finish at the backend from Pakistan as they amassed 99 runs from the last 10 overs. Still, the way they batted, at one stage, a score of 350 looked very much likely. Keeping that in mind, the visiting team will be a shade disappointed.

Slower one, short and outside off, Agha Salman tries his best to pull but gets a bottom edge. The ball drops on the pitch and they get only a run. A terrific last over from Bas de Leede, only 7 runs from it.​ Pakistan finish on 314 for 6.
Bang on the body again. Clever change in pace, on a length and around off, Shadab swings his bat early and misses. He is hit on the stomach and the ball drops on the off side. They cross.
Lands it on a length and outside off, Shadab gets across and forces it down to long on for a couple.
Ouch! Slower one, on a shortish length around off, Shadab is early into his shot and is hit on the body.

PUT DOWN! Vikramjit Singh drops a routine catch. Fuller in length and outside off, Shadab slices his attempted shot over extra cover. Vikramjit Singh fails to take it in the deep and the batters get two runs.
Digs it in short around off, it's pulled to deep square leg for a single.
SIX! High and handsome! This is why Shadab was itching to get back on strike. A length ball in his half, around off, Khan kneels down and muscles it all the way over long on. 17 from the over!
Back of a length, around middle, Afgha moves back and punches it aerially down to long on. Only a run this time.
FOUR! Easy pickings! This is poor bowling. Third man is up and van Beek bowls it short and wide outside off. Agha gives himself room and lofts it over short third man for a boundary. 300 up!
Mishit! Fuller and around off, slower again, Salman tries to hoick but it takes the top edge and flies behind the keeper. They get two runs.
Beats the bat! A good change in pace from the bowler. Slower one, short and around off, Agha flashes his bat at it and misses.
FOUR! Improvisation and it has paid off. A length delivery, around off, Salman goes down and across and scoops it down to fine leg for a boundary.
Fuller and on middle, Salman steps back and drills it down to long off for a single. 8 runs from the over, at this stage, it's a good effort from the bowler.
Slower again, full and on middle, Shadab heaves it without much timing to deep mid-wicket for one.
Wide! Slips a full ball down the leg side, Shadab tries to flick but misses.
A low full toss down the leg side, Agha swings it down to deep square leg. Only a run.
Drifting down the leg side, it's flicked to deep square leg for two.
Digs it in short and outside off, Khan slaps it to deep cover for just a run. He is not impressed with himself.
Short and around leg, slow in pace, it's hoicked behind square leg for one.
Vivian Kingma will bowl at the death. 8-2-53-1 are his figures.
Turns a length ball off his pads to deep square leg and takes a single. Shadab wants the second run but it's turned down. 15 from the over!
FOUR! Poor delivery, too short, too wide, outside off, Agha Salman cuts it firmly through backward point for a boundary.
The batter has just pushed that away from his crease, back to the bowler.

A length ball on middle, Shadab clips it to mid-wicket and crosses for a couple of runs as the bowler gives the chase. He has a shy at the bowler's end but it hits Teja Nidamanuru, up to the stumps, on the knee and deflects. They cross for another run.
FOUR! Short in length and outside off, Shadab stays back and smacks it to deep point. Tim Pringle tries to stop it near the fence but misses.
Crunches a length ball through extra cover for three runs.

A cutter this time, around off and on a length, the batter tries to flick but misses. He is thudded on the pads and the ball rolls to mid-wicket. They cross as the bowler appeals. The replays find an inside edge. The debutant is off the mark.
Logan van Beek (8-0-57-2) has been brought into the attack.
Agha Salman has made his way out to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! A tame dismissal for Nawaz. Bas de Leede has his second wicket. Short in length and outside off, slower in pace, Nawaz goes on his toes and tries to slam it over point. The ball though arrives late and takes the top half of his blade. It lobs up to Vivian Kingma at short third man who makes no mistake on this occasion.
Commentary.Howout: c Vivian Kingma b Bas de Leede

Commentary.Commentary: Slower bumper on middle, Nawaz moves back and allows it through.
Slower length ball on off, Shadab works it through mid-wicket for another run. Netherlands won't mind these singles.
Taps it down to point for one.
Tucks a length ball off his pads to deep square leg. Shadab picks up a single.
Short and outside off, forced off the back foot to deep point for one. Excellent over from Aryan Dutt, just 5 runs from it.
Skidding down the leg side, Nawaz goes back to flick but misses. It goes off his thigh pad to backward square leg and they take a leg bye.

Shout for an lbw, not given! Quicker one, full and around leg, Mohammad Nawaz tries to defend but misses. It takes his pads and deflects to the off side. They appeal but the umpire disagrees. Scott Edwards has decided to take the DRS. The UltraEdge detects an inside edge.
Flatter and around off, tapped down to the off side for one.

NOT OUT! But it was superb glovework from the keeper. Aryan Dutt fires a full ball down the leg side. Shadab tries to flick but misses and in the process, he steps out of the crease. Scott Edwards is quick to take the bails off and appeals. The third umpire is referred. He first checks for the edge which is absent. The side-on angle is checked next and the replays find that Shadab has put his leg just inside the crease. It's called a wide.
Appeal for a stumping...
Quicker and fuller on middle, Nawaz tries to flick and does so off the inner edge. It rolls behind square leg and they cross.
Short in length and outside off, Nawaz cuts it a bit aerially but it goes safely to point.
Aryan Dutt (8-1-40-0) has been brought into the attack. This will be a challenge for him, bowling at batters looking to go after him.

SIX! Dispatched! That's a costly error from van Beek and he pays the price. Short in length, around off, Shadab stays back and launches it over mid-wicket for a biggie. 15 from this over, 32 in the last two.
FOUR! Beamer from van Beek. A high full toss, around leg, Shadab turns and powers it behind square leg for a boundary. Called a no ball and a Free Hit is loading. 250 up!
Width outside off, it's slashed away down to third man for a single.
Wide called for height! A bumper goes way over the head of the batter. Nawaz ducks.
Slightly short and around off, Shadab pushes it with soft hands through mid on and calls for two. The fielder in the deep attacks the ball and Shadab has to give up the thought for the second run.
Short in length, close to off, Shadab chops it down in front of backward point. Looks for a run but it is not available.
Angling away from the new batter, on a length, Nawaz taps it down to cover and crosses for a run.
Mohammad Nawaz is the new batter out in the middle.

OUT! Khushdil holes out! Fuller in length and around off, at 77 mph, Shah clears his front leg for a big heave-ho over the leg side but it flies off the toe end of his bat to wide long on. Tom Cooper is perfectly placed in the deep to take the catch. End of a quick knock from Khushdil Shah.
Commentary.Howout: c Tom Cooper b Logan van Beek

Commentary.Commentary: Slower length ball around leg, Shah nudges it behind square leg and takes a run. 17 from the over!

SIX! This is turning out to be a disastrous over for the Dutch. Vivian Kingma digs it in short, around off and slower in pace, Khushdil Shah waits and pummels it in front of square on the leg side for a maximum.
Lands it on a good length and outside off, slower again, Shadab runs it down to third man and picks up a single.
FOUR! Bang! Kingma delivers yet another slower one. This one is floated and drops full outside off, Shadab waits and pumps it over extra cover for a boundary.
A length ball around leg, slower in pace, Shah tries to flick but misses. It rolls off his pads to the on side and they cross for a leg bye.
FOUR! Smashed straight back! Fuller in length around off, in the slot for the batter, Shah spanks it past the umpire at the other end and it scoots away to the fence in no time.
Vivian Kingma (7-2-37-1) has been brought back into the attack.
Another slower one, on a good length around leg, Shah nudges it to square leg and keeps strike with a single.
Slower bouncer, around off, Khushdil sways away from the line.
Quick single. On a length around off, Shadab taps it down to short cover and sets off. Teja Nidamanuru attacks the ball but fails to pick it up cleanly. A single completed easily.
Angling in, on a length, around off, Shadab again defends it to the off side.
Around off, on a length, pushed to covers.
FOUR! A good start to the over for Pakistan. Too full in length, around middle, Shadab drills it back past the bowler and it races down the ground for a boundary at long on.
Too full in length, around off, Shah pushes it back to the bowler. Pringle is done with his spell.
Flatter and shorter, outside off, Shah goes back and cuts it to deep point for two.
Quicker one, around leg, Shadab tucks it to deep mid-wicket and takes a run. He looks for the second run but is sent back.
Flatter and around off, Shah goes back again and hits it through mid-wicket for a run.
Short and outside off, Shah cuts but finds the point fielder.
Fuller and outside off, driven to deep cover for a single.
Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this inning.
Bas de Leede bowls this short and attacks the batter, Khushdil Shah gets on his toes and fends this uppishly back to the bowler. Falls just short of him.

NOT OUT! Bas de Leede bowls this back of a length and in line with the stumps, Shadab Khan clips the ball towards mid-wicket and looks for a quick single. Khushdil Shah sends him back and Shadab Khan has to put a dive back in. There is a direct hit at the striker's end and the ball ricochets to third man for a run. The leg umpire goes upstairs and the replays show that Shadab Khan has made it back in.
A direct hit at the striker's end. Netherlands are excited, they appeal and the umpire goes upstairs...
Bangs this one short and angling down leg, Shadab Khan looks to pull but misses, then looks for a wide. The umpire remains unmoved.
Bas de Leede goes 'round the wicket to the left-hander and serves this a fraction fuller outside off, Khushdil Shah taps this towards covers and takes a run.
Bas de Leede bowls this full and outside off, Shadab Khan strokes this past covers and gets off the mark with a single.
Shadab Khan is in next.

OUT! Given lbw! Mohammad Rizwan has a word with his partner and takes the review. This one looks close. Coming to the delivery, it's on a length around off, angling in, Rizwan stays back and tries to flick but misses. He is rapped on the front pad, they appeal vociferously and the finger goes up. DRS time! The UltraEdge finds no bat and the Ball Tracking shows that it's clipping the leg stump. The on-field decision stays and Rizwan walks back for yet another low score. This is a good phase of play for the home team.
Bas de Leede to continue...
Tim Pringle bowls this full and outside off, Mohammad Rizwan plays this towards cover-point and takes one more run.
Floats this one full and in line with the stumps, Khushdil Shah works this to long on for a single.
Tim Pringle goes a fraction short but keeps it straight. Mohammad Rizwan goes back in the crease and plays the ball with soft hands towards mid off and takes a run.
SIX! Rizwan goes high, goes long and goes all the way! Floated delivery, full and wide outside off, Mohammad Rizwan shuffles across and smashes it over long on for a biggie.
Bowls a full-length delivery on middle and leg, Khushdil Shah clips this towards deep square leg for a run.
Tim Pringle flights this one full and outside off, Mohammad Rizwan works this past point or a single.

This delivery has definitely troubled the batter. Bas de Leede bangs this one short and angling into the body. Khushdil Shah pulls awkwardly and gets gloves on this as it flies just over the keeper's left. The ball rolls to third man for a couple of runs.
Straying onto the pads from a good length. Mohammad Rizwan clips this towards deep square leg and takes an easy single.
Bas de Leede bowls this on a good length and angling into the batter once again Mohammad Rizwan knocks this towards mid-wicket.
Uses the angle of the bowler and works it on the leg side. Finds short mid-wicket. Three dots, pressure building.
Fuller and outside off, driven through the line but straight to the short cover fielder.
Starts a new spell with a length ball on middle, Rizwan taps it down to mid-wicket and sets off for a run. He is set back.
Bas de Leede (6-0-26-0) is back on.
Flighted and full, around off, Rizwan goes down and sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Fuller and on off, forced down to long on for a single.
Flatter and outside off, Shah offers no shot and lets it through to the keeper.
Khushdil Shah walks in next.

OUT! RUN OUT! Pakistan lose a completely avoidable wicket! Tim Pringle goes full and outside the off pole, Fakhar Zaman goes for the sweep and plays the ball firmly towards deep mid-wicket. They look for two runs but Bas de Leede does wonderfully well in the deep and collects the ball cleanly. The throw is right on top of the stumps at the keeper's end. Fakhar Zaman is well short despite his dive as Scott Edwards whips the bails off. The centurion has to depart and the Netherlands have a couple of wickets in quick succession - both the set batters dismissed.
Commentary.Howout: run out (Bas de Leede / Scott Edwards)

Commentary.Commentary: Flighted full and outside off, Mohammad Rizwan strokes this to deep cover and takes a single.
Tim Pringle begins with a full delivery outside off, Mohammad Rizwan knocks this towards cover.
Tim Pringle is back into the attack. 0 for 45 in his 7 overs so far.
FOUR! Third boundary in this over! Aryan Dutt flights this one as well and serves this full outside off, Fakhar Zaman sweeps this towards deep backward square leg for a boundary.
Aryan Dutt floats this one full on middle and off, Fakhar Zaman defends this back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Delicate! Flatter and around off, Fakhar plays very late, uses the pace of the bowler and runs it down past short third man for a boundary.
Goes down and across to a full ball and sweeps it behind square leg for one.

HUNDRED FOR FAKHAR ZAMAN! His 7th in ODIs. Full and flighted on middle, Zaman eases it down to long on for a run. Dropped on 43, Fakhar has made the Netherlands pay heavily. Off comes the helmet and Fakhar Zaman acknowledges the crowd by raising his bat.

FOUR! Fakhar Zaman reaches 99 with that boundary! Aryan Dutt flights this one full and angling into the batter. Fakhar Zaman shimmies down the wicket and lifts the ball over mid off and the ball runs away to long off for a boundary.
Fullish and on middle, pushed down to mid on. End of an excellent over, 4 runs and a wicket from it.
Angles in a length ball around off, Rizwan pushes it with soft hands to covers and takes a few steps down the track before yelling a loud no.
Taps a length ball down to cover-point and pinches a single.
Short in length and outside off, punched to sweeper cover for one.
Mohammad Rizwan makes his way out to the middle and there is a loud cheer from the crowd.

OUT! CAUGHT! At last, the Netherlands have a breakthrough as they get rid of Babar Azam. The stand worth 168 runs has been put to an end. It's on a good length, around off, Babar clears his front leg and tries to heave it over mid-wicket. The ball though takes the top edge and flies to mid off where Tom Cooper takes a simple catch at the edge of the circle. Runs had dried out in the last few overs and the Pakistan skipper, in an attempt to cut loose, departs.
Commentary.Howout: c Tom Cooper b Logan van Beek

Commentary.Commentary: Shortish and on middle, tapped down to square leg for one.
Wide called for height! Too short from van Beek and it sails over the head of the batter.
Logan van Beek has been reintroduced into the attack. He has been expensive conceding 32 runs in his five overs without a wicket.
Walks down the track to receive a full ball but only manages to drive it towards the cover fielder. A dot ball to end the over, 4 from it.
Play and a miss! Some extra bounce this time, outside off, Azam tries to cut from the back foot but it bounces over his bat.
Picks the gap this time. Aryan drags his length short and serves it outside off, Babar goes back and cuts it to deep point for a couple.
Fullish and around off, forced down to long off for one.
Loopy and full, around off, Babar Azam goes down to slog-sweep but only drags it to deep mid-wicket. They cross.
Fails to put it away! Short in length and outside off, Babar cuts but finds the point fielder.
Aryan Dutt (6-1-22-0) has been brought back for his third spell.
Full and around middle, angling down, Fakhar tries to whip across the line but misses. They appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Missing leg.
Fuller and around off, Fakhar plays a crunching drive but finds the fielder inside the ring at covers. Stays on 92.
Slower one, short and around off, Babar picks it but still pulls it straight towards the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Only a run.
Back of a length, around off, Azam taps it down to point.
Poor delivery, short and down the leg side, Babar turns inside the crease and sends it down to fine leg. Two runs.
Angles in a length ball on middle, Azam stays back and defends it to the leg side.

A touch short and on middle, Babar goes on the back foot and tucks it in front of square on the leg side. Picks up a single. A couple of good overs from Cooper and the Netherlands are pulling things back after a brief period of carnage.
Fuller and around off, driven to extra cover where the fielder made a partial stop and parried it to mid off. They crossed.
Hits the blockhole this time, Fakhar digs it out to short cover.
Too full and around leg, swept to deep square leg for one.
Flighted and around off, fuller in length, Zaman eases it down to long off for a single.
Loopy and full around off, Babar gently flicks it through mid-wicket and calls for two. He gets only a run.
Short again, outside off, this time Babar punches and finds the gap at covers for a single. 10 an over from here will take Pakistan to 354. They will certainly target that!
Shortish and around off, punched from the back foot to cover-point.
Bouncer around off, at 77 mph, Babar sways away from the line.
Eases it down to long on and picks up a single.
Short and around off, Fakhar pulls but without much timing. The mid-wicket fielder makes the stop. Two dots.
Full and around off, angling in from 'round the wicket, Zaman defends it on the leg side.
Bas de Leede is back on. 0 for 21 in his 4 overs so far.
Tom Cooper goes straighter on a fuller length. Fakhar Zaman works this towards long on for a single. Quite an eventful over from Tom Cooper!

The rub of the green is definitely in favour of Fakhar Zaman! Tom Cooper bowls a loopy delivery full and wide outside off, Fakhar Zaman looks for the expansive drive and gets a thick outside edge that falls well in front of short third man.
Tom Cooper continues flighting this full outside off, Fakhar Zaman pushes this towards mid off.

Fakhar Zaman is living a charmed life! Tom Cooper flights this one full and outside off, Fakhar Zaman charges down the wicket and looks to heave this across the line. Ends up slicing the ball towards the vacant deep cover region and the ball lands safely. They take two runs in the meantime.
Tom Cooper bowls this full and outside off, Fakhar Zaman looks to play this towards point and take a quick run. Babar Azam refuses.

Slight halt in play as Tom Cooper has hurt his fingers and getting some running repairs done. The umpires have decided to take the Drinks break. It's been a complete turnaround in the last few overs. We questioned Pakistan's slow approach but it seems to have paid off. It was a smart strategy, they made the Dutch team comfortable with their initial approach and then launched a sudden attack. The hosts are taken by surprise and are running helter-skelter. If this onslaught continues, Pakistan will cruise to a very imposing total. Can the Netherlands limit the damage?
Tom Cooper begins with a loopy delivery, full and in line with the stumps, Fakhar Zaman defends this to the left of the bowler. Tom Cooper seems to have cut his finger going for the ball.
Tom Cooper is getting ready to bowl his part-time off spinners.
Vivian Kingma ends with a good-length delivery outside off, Babar Azam knocks this straight to the cover fielder. A much better over for the Netherlands after a while.
Slower delivery once again, served on a length and outside off, Fakhar Zaman waits for it and guides it late towards third man for one run.
Vivian Kingma bowls a full toss on the pads, Fakhar Zaman flicks this towards deep square leg and they run well to get two runs.
Slower ball bowled back of a length and outside off, Babar Azam pulls this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Vivian Kingma goes full now and in line with the stumps, Fakhar Zaman knocks this to mid on and takes a quick run as the fielder is on his heels.
Vivian Kingma starts off this over with a good-length delivery outside off. Babar Azam takes an easy single as he guides the ball to third man.
Flatter and on middle, it's knocked down to wide long on for a run. 11 from this over.
Shortish and on middle, punched to deep mid-wicket for a brisk couple of runs.
Flighted and full, outside off, Fakhar goes down and slogs it down towards wide long on. The fielder is stationed there and hence only a run. 150 up for Pakistan!
Tim Pringle goes short now to compensate and Babar Azam works this to deep square leg for a single.
SIX! Babar Azam is looking really dangerous! Tim Pringle flights this one full outside off, Babar Azam gets down on one knee and slog-sweeps the ball over deep mid-wicket for a maximum!
Tim Pringle bowls this short and wide outside off, Babar Azam cuts this straight to point.
Vivian Kingma serves this on a length and offers width, Babar Azam guides the ball to third man to take a run and keep strike.
Much better from Vivian Kingma as he bowls this on a good length and outside off, Fakhar Zaman plays this with soft hands towards cover and they steal a quick single.
Change of footwear for Vivian Kingma and a banana for Fakhar Zaman. Slight halt in play.​ Pakistan are on the attack and Netherlands are feeling the heat.
SIX! BANG! That has flown away! Vivian Kingma bowls a slower delivery angling into the pads, Fakhar Zaman uses all his power to muscle this over fine leg for a huge hit!
Fuller and on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Pulls his length back a fraction, and delivers this just outside the off pole. Babar Azam fends this back to the bowler.
Vivian Kingma serves this on a good length and outside off, Fakhar Zaman works this to deep point for a single.
Vivian Kingma comes back into the attack. He dropped Fakhar Zaman on 43, can he make amends?

FOUR! Third boundary of the over! Tim Pringle goes back to bowling short and outside off, Babar Azam rocks back and pulls this towards wide long on. The long on fielder gets there but slides over the ball. Babar Azam gets to his half-century and he has been the catalyst for their attack.
Tim Pringle flights this one full and angling into the pads, Babar Azam clips this towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Babar Azam wants to feast on runs as well! Tim Pringle is short once again and outside off, Babar Azam takes a step back and cuts this towards deep point for four runs.
Tim Pringle bowls this one short and in line with the stumps, Fakhar Zaman shimmies down the wicket and smashes the ball straight to long off for a single.
FOUR! Up and away! Tim Pringle flights this one full and outside the off stump, Fakhar Zaman lofts the ball towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tim Pringle fires a full delivery into the stumps, Fakhar Zaman defends this back to the bowler.
Tim Pringle (5-0-21-0) is back on.
Short and on off, slower in pace, Fakhar this time drags his attempted pull shot down to deep backward square leg. Only a run. 12 from this over, and at the halfway stage, Pakistan are 119 for 1.
FOUR! A pick-up shot this time, in the same area and a boundary again. Full this time, around middle and leg, Fakhar picks it off his pads and whips it over backward square leg.
FOUR! Finds the fence! Short in length, around off, nicely sitting up for the batter, Fakhar clears his front leg and powers it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Around middle, on a good length, Babar eases it to deep square leg for one. The century stand comes up, off 115 balls!
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, on a length, Babar tries to tickle it fine but misses. The Pakistan skipper is not happy with himself.
Again a slower one, short in length and outside off, Fakhar dabs it down to third man for one.
Slower one, full and around off, Zaman forces it down to wide mid on where Cooper makes a fine stop.
Bas de Leede has been asked to bowl now. He has been impressive so far giving just 9 runs in his 3 overs.
Slants it in, on a length, Babar stays back and defends it to mid-wicket. 7 from this over, 33 in the last three. The charge is on!
Outside off, on a length, played from the back foot to covers.
Slightly short and outside off, Babar camps back and steers it down to the right of third man. They take two runs.
Bunts a full ball down to mid off and steals a quick run. The purpose to have a mid off is defeated there. Should have prevented the single.
Short and wide outside off, Fakhar slaps it in the air but it goes safely to deep point. They take two.
Fuller in length and around leg, Zaman whips it to deep square leg and picks up a couple of runs.
Turning in from around off, Babar punches it from the inner half to mid-wicket. 26 runs in the last two overs for Pakistan.
FOUR! Put away in style. 100 up for Pakistan. Dutt drags his length short, around off, Babar Azam goes deep inside the crease and hammer-pulls it to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Tossed up, around middle, Fakhar helps it towards backward square leg and rotates the strike.
Short again, this time outside off, Azam slaps it to deep point for a single.
FOUR! Yet another boundary. The runs continue to flow for Pakistan. Short in length around middle, spinning down, Babar Azam pulls it past short fine leg and picks up a boundary.
Flighted and on off, Babar goes on the back foot and works it to mid-wicket.

Width there outside off, short in length, Azam camps back and flat-bats it through backward point. Aryan Dutt makes a fine stop, running across to his right from third man, saves one run. 16 from the over and Pakistan are perhaps looking to shift gears.
FOUR! Pakistan are motoring now! A low full toss around off, angling in, Babar Azam crunches it down the ground and beats mid off to find the fence.
Fraction short and on middle, Babar goes back and turns it behind square leg. Calls two and returns safely. All of a sudden, there is a change in tempo for Pakistan.
Short in length again, outside off, Babar rocks back and whacks it through cover-point. Vikramjit Singh dives near the fence and saves two runs for his team.
Short and wide outside off, Fakhar steers it down to third man and picks up a single.

FOUR! Another lucky escape for Fakhar Zaman and he brings up his fifty with this mishit. Short in length, outside off, Fakhar dances down the track and tries to pull. But it takes the top edge and flies down to fine leg for a boundary.
Logan van Beek has been brought back into the attack. He has conceded 9 runs in his three overs.
Floated this time, full and on middle, Fakhar flicks it through square leg for a run. Just one from the over.
Flatter again, it's fired around off, Zaman defends it from the crease.
Quicker through the air, around off, Fakhar walks forward and defends.
Flatter and shorter on off, Fakhar chops it down from the back foot to point.
Loopy and full, around off, Fakhar defends it off the front foot.
Shout for a caught behind! Not given. Fuller and down the leg side, Zaman tries to flick but misses. Maybe, there was some pad involved.
Aryan Dutt is back into the attack. 4-1-11-0 are his figures so far.

Tim Pringle pulls his length back and fires this into the stumps, Fakhar Zaman uses the depth of the crease to work this towards deep square leg for a run. Good over once again from Tim Pringle as he concedes just three runs.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside off, Babar Azam takes a stride forward and works the ball to long off for a single.
Arm ball fired into the stumps from a shorter length. Babar Azam goes back in the crease and keeps it out late from the bottom edge. That was close.
Tim Pringle sees the batter charging and bowls the ball short and in line with the stumps. Babar Azam adjusts and plays it to mid-wicket.
Tim Pringle flights this one full onto the pads,  Fakhar Zaman flicks the ball to deep square leg for a single.
Tim Pringle bowls this full and serves this outside off, Fakhar Zaman defends this towards point.

Bas de Leede angles this one into the pads from a fuller length. Fakhar Zaman looks to work this leg side but misses. The ball hits the pads and rolls to backward square leg where the keeper runs to collect as they take a leg bye.
Back-of-a-length delivery bowled outside off, Babar Azam gets on his toes and works the ball to deep cover-point for a run.
Goes short once again and outside the off pole, Babar Azam looks to slash at it but misses.
Bas de Leede bangs this in short and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam ducks under this one.

DROPPED! Kingma has put down a simple catch and is crestfallen. Costly miss. Back of a length and outside off, Fakhar Zaman camps back to heave it over the leg side but it takes the top edge and flies down to third man. Vivian Kingma moves across to his right but fails to hold on to the catch. The batters take a run.
Fuller in length and around middle, slower in pace, Fakhar defends it to the leg side.
Tim Pringle loops this full and outside the off pole. Fakhar Zaman works this towards point for a single.
Tim Pringle slows the ball in the air and bowls this in line with the stumps, Fakhar Zaman defends this to the leg side.
Goes short this time and outside off, Babar Azam uses the crease and pulls the ball to deep square leg for a single.
Flights this one full and outside off, Babar Azam knocks this straight to the cover fielder.
Tim Pringle serves this full and angling into the pads, Babar Azam clips this towards mid-wicket.

Two wides! Tim Pringle delivers this a fraction short and angling down leg. Fakhar Zaman leaves this alone and the keeper cannot collect cleanly. They get an extra run as the ball goes towards short fine leg.
Tim Pringle bowls this full and angling into the left-hander. Fakhar Zaman defends this back towards the bowler.
Scott Edwards wears his helmet and comes up to the stumps as Tim Pringle returns for his second spell. 0 for 14 from his 3 overs so far.
A fraction full and straighter this time. Babar Azam knocks this to mid on and looks for a single. No run there. Just three runs off this over.
Bas de Leede goes back to bowling on a good length and on an off-stump line. Babar Azam defends this towards mid on.
Goes full and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam clips this towards mid-wicket.
Bas de Leede delivers this on a good length and outside off, Fakhar Zaman works this to the right of the diving backward point fielder for a single to third man.
Slight halt in play. Is it a wasp sting on Fakhar Zaman's left elbow? Yup. The physio rushes out. All is good now and Fakhar Zaman is ready to take guard.
Bowls this on a good length and outside off, Babar Azam guides the ball to third man for a run.
Bas de Leede runs in after the break and bowls a yorker in line with the stumps, Fakhar Zaman clips this to deep square leg for a single.

Drinks break. Slow going from Pakistan but that's more by choice than compulsion. The Netherlands have bowled decently, not much threatening but they have been treated with extra respect from the Pakistan batters so far. Babar Azam and Fakhar Zaman have raised a 50-run stand and looking to prepare a good launching pad for a big finish at the backend. Can the Dutch team pick a few wickets in the middle phase to create some pressure? Let's find out.
Logan van Beek tucks the batter in with a delivery from a good length. Babar Azam can only defend this towards mid-wicket.
Good-length delivery bowled outside the off pole. Babar Azam strokes this well towards the point fielder.
Bangs it in short and serves this outside off, Fakhar Zaman pulls this to deep square leg for a single. The 50-run stand comes up!
Logan van Beek goes full once again and in line with the stumps, Fakhar Zaman clips this to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Slower delivery bowled on a good length and angling down leg, Babar Azam waits on it and nudges it to fine leg for a single.
Logan van Beek bowls this full and outside off, Babar Azam knocks this back to the bowler.
Short in length and outside off, Babar plays a mistimed pull shot to deep mid-wicket for a run.
On a length and outside off, Zaman plays late and guides it down to third man for a run.

Fuller and around off, Fakhar pushes it down to wide mid on for a quick run. The fielder, Tom Cooper, scores a direct hit at the bowler's end, it deflects away to deep cover and they cross for one more.
Darts in a length ball, around middle and leg and it skids on, Fakhar tries to flick but gets a little leading edge towards mid-wicket.
Slight halt! The physios are out for the mandatory concussion check. Fakhar Zaman looks alright and they are checking the helmet. All seems good now and play is set to resume.
Bang on the helmet! Bas de Leede digs it in short, around middle, Fakhar tries to pull but misses. He is hit on the helmet and the ball drops near the fence.
Excellent start! Back of a length, around off and angling in, Fakhar stays back to defend but it straightens to beat the outside edge.
Bas de Leede has been given the ball now.
Drifting down the leg side, on a good length, Fakhar tries to flick but misses. It goes off his pads to backward square leg and they pick up a leg bye.
Slower one, a loopy low full toss on off, Fakhar bunts it down to mid off.
Angling in, full in length, it's clipped away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Wide called for height! Logan digs it in short, around leg and well over the head of the batter. 50 comes up for Pakistan with this extra.
Play and a miss! Full and wide outside off, Babar is lured into the drive away from his body but he fails to make any connection. A bit loose from the Pakistan skipper.
Back of a length, around off, Azam goes on the back foot and turns it on the leg side, finds short mid-wicket.
Delivers it full and angles it around off, Babar defends it back with a straight bat.
Pringle bowls from 'round the wicket and serves it full around off, Fakhar gets on the front foot and defends.
Nicely tossed up, full and on middle, Babar drives it down to long off and rotates the strike.
Fuller and on off, eased down to long on for a single.
Lovely touch! A shade short and outside off, Fakhar plays late, almost off the keeper's gloves and guides it past short third man for a couple of runs.
Loopy and full around off, Babar gets forward to defend but it takes the inner edge and rolls to square leg. It's in the gap and they cross.
Shortish and outside off, Fakhar Zaman taps it down to short third man and steals a quick run.
Another mistimed shot from Babar. Full and outside off, Azam tries to drive but it takes the bottom part of his bat and lobs on the leg side. All of a sudden, this pitch is looking two-paced.
Too full and around leg, Fakhar flicks it to deep square leg for a single.

Excellent partial stop. Short in length and outside off, Babar slaps it to backward point where Max O'Dowd dives across to his left and takes the pace off the ball. Saves a certain boundary. Only one run added to the total.
Aerial but safe! This one holds a bit off the surface, on a length outside off, Babar checks his drive and pushes it towards mid off.
Extra bounce from a length around off, Babar goes back to work it on the leg side but it takes the splice of his bat and rolls to covers.
Full and on off, Babar flicks it across the line but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Wide! Wrong start. It's served down the leg side, on a good length, Babar tries to flick but misses.
Logan van Beek has been brought into the attack.
Spinning in from around off, Fakhar goes on the back foot and helps it straight towards short fine leg. Another good over from Tim.
Tossed up, full and outside off, Fakhar strides forward and defends it back.

Appeal for a run out! A touch short and outside off, Babar plays late and guides it towards backward point. The fielder there dives but fails to make the stop. The batters decide to take a run. The fielder is quick to recover and fires in a throw to the keeper who dislodges the bails. They appeal, it's referred upstairs. The replays find Fakhar Zaman safely in.
Leans forward to a full ball and pushes it defensively to covers.
Very full, outside off, Fakhar knocks it down to long on and rotates the strike.
Loopy and full, outside off, Azam drives it through cover-point for a single.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.

Goes back to bowling on a good length and just outside off, Fakhar Zaman defends this towards mid on. 14 from the over, the banter with Fakhar Zaman seems to have put off Kingma. At the end of Powerplay 1, Pakistan are 37 for 1.

FOUR! Streaky boundary this time but they get two in a row! Vivian Kingma delivers this full and outside off, Fakhar Zaman looks to defend this but gets a thick outside edge that flies through the vacant slip cordon and runs away to the third man region for four more runs.

FOUR! Fakhar Zaman finally getting into the groove here! Vivian Kingma bowls this a fraction full and outside off, Fakhar Zaman is seeing the ball well now and he slaps this towards the deep point fence for another boundary.
Sliding down the leg side, Babar eases it off his pads down to deep backward square leg for a run.
FOUR! This is class! Kingma lands it on a length and outside off, Babar stays back and elegantly puts it away through cover-point for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, Zaman goes back and cuts it down to third man for a run.
Full and outside off, Babar Azam pushes this towards backward point. Good comeback from Tim Pringle after conceding a boundary on his first ball.
Tim Pringle bowls this on a yorker length and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam digs this out to the bowler.
Tim Pringle gets this full outside off once again. Fakhar Zaman guides this towards short third man and takes a run.
Full and angling into the stumps, Fakhar Zaman works this towards mid-wicket.
Better from Tim Pringle. He serves this closer to the off pole on a fuller length. Fakhar Zaman defends this on the off side.

FOUR! Tim Pringle starts with a poor delivery! He flights this one and lands it really full and wide outside off, Fakhar Zaman gets a stride forward and caresses the ball through the gap in the offside and the ball races to the deep cover-point fence for four runs.
A few words were exchanged between Vivian Kingma and Fakhar Zaman after the over. Change in bowling. Tim Pringle to have a go inside Powerplay 1.
Vivian Kingma bowls this a fraction full and on leg, Fakhar Zaman flicks this to the left of mid on and takes a single.

FOUR! Finally a boundary! This was a release shot from Fakhar Zaman! Vivian Kingma bowls this on a good length and a fraction wider outside off, Fakhar Zaman charges down the wicket and has room to swing his arms. Gets the ball towards the backward point fence but does not connect well. The ball trickles past the ropes.
Good bowling here from Vivian Kingma. He is keeping it tight. Bowls a good-length delivery on off, Fakhar Zaman fends this back to the bowler.
Vivian Kingma continues bowling on a good length and outside the off pole. Fakhar Zaman is happy to leave this one alone.
Good-length delivery in line with the stumps, Babar Azam clips this towards deep square leg and takes a single.

What a beauty! Vivian Kingma is looking in good rhythm! He serves this back of a length and just outside off, Babar Azam hangs his bat out to dry and gets beaten on the outside edge. He was opened you up like a can of beans. This is brilliant bowling.
Goes full and bowls this outside the off pole, Fakhar Zaman pushes forward and gets a thickish edge towards cover-point. Tidy stuff from Aryan Dutt.
A touch short and angling into the stumps, Babar Azam rocks back in his crease and plays this off the back foot to long on and takes a single. He is off the mark.
Aryan Dutt fires this one quick and angling into the pads, Babar Azam clips this towards mid-wicket.
Flighted once again and delivered full outside the off stump, Babar Azam defends this to the bowler's left.
Aryan Dutt serves this one full and outside off, Babar Azam defends this solidly towards cover.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Fakhar cuts it with the spin to deep cover-point for a single.
Babar Azam, the superstar of Pakistan's batting, walks in next amidst a huge cheer from the crowd.

OUT! LBW! Imam-ul-Haq has to depart! The Netherlands have drawn first blood! Vivian Kingma bowls this fuller and swings the ball into the left-handed batter from around middle and leg. Imam-ul-Haq plays all over this one and misses the line of the ball. It hits him on the pads and the Dutch players go up in a huge appeal. The umpire though disagrees. Scott Edwards decides to review this after some contemplation. UltraEdge shows there is no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows all three reds and the on-field umpire has to overturn his decision! What a breakthrough for Netherlands and Pakistan's watchful start has not paid off!

DRS time! Imam-ul-Haq is the batter in question. He has failed to flick an inswinger and is rapped on the pads. Looks close but the finger stays down. Scott Edwards has decided to review the decision. Nothing on the UltraEdge and the Ball Tracking shows that it's hitting the leg stump. All over for Imam-ul-Haq!
Good-length delivery once again and in line with the stumps, Imam-ul-Haq defends this back to the left of the bowler.
Closer to the batter this time from a good length. Imam-ul-Haq fends this solidly towards point.
Pulls his length back a fraction and serves this outside the off stump. Imam-ul-Haq hits this straight to cover.
Kingma goes a fraction full and strays on the pads, Imam-ul-Haq misses his flick and the ball hits his pads and rolls to the leg side.
Vivian Kingma bowls this on a good length, and just outside off, Imam-ul-Haq attempts a lazy shot inside the line and gets beaten.
Flatter and on middle, Zaman stays back and defends it from the inner half to mid-wicket. 7 from the over but that doesn't tell the entire story.
Quicker one again, full and around leg, Zaman tries to defend but misses. He is hit on the pads, they appeal but unsuccessfully.
Goes back and eases it behind square leg for a couple of runs.

EDGY FOUR! Fakhar tries to attack Aryan but fails to connect well. He is lucky there. Loopy and full, around off, Fakhar Zaman runs down the track to heave it over the leg side but it turns away to take the outside edge. The ball flies past Vikramjit Singh at first slip and races away to the fence at third man.
Quicker one, it's fired in flat around off, Imam tucks it through square leg and picks up a single.
Flighted and around off, Imam goes back and helps it on the leg side.
Well bowled! A lot of zip and bounce on this delivery. Around off on a good length and angling away, Fakhar stays back to push inside the line of this delivery but misses.
Fraction short in length and outside off, Imam goes on the back foot and guides it down to third man. Finally, Imam opens his account, after 10 balls.
Shout for an lbw, a muted one though. A length delivery, around leg, Imam tries to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Pitching outside leg, perhaps some inside edge too.
Kingma goes fuller and lands it outside off, Imam gets forward to drive but it takes the inner half and rolls back to the bowler.
First shot of real intent from Imam. He rocks back to a short ball outside off and cuts, but finds the point fielder.
On a length around off, pushed from the back foot to covers.
Fuller and around off, Fakhar stretches forward and offers a straight blade in defense. Another maiden, two in a row. To be honest, Pakistan are being needlessly overcautious at the moment.
Quicker through the air, around off, defended from the back foot to the leg side.
Short and on off, Fakhar taps it down to covers and looks for a run. He is sent back.
Slower through the air this time, full and on middle, Zaman defends it off the inner half to square leg.
Fires it in, flat and around off, the ball skids in and Fakhar defends it to mid-wicket.
Whoa! Turn and bounce for Aryan. He goes flatter and lands it on off, it kisses the deck and turns square. Fakhar stays back inside the crease and leaves.
Maiden! Vivian Kingma delivers yet another delivery in the zone outside off, taking it away with his natural angle. Imam-ul-Haq stays put with his leaving game.
Kingma is sticking to his line outside off, bowling it on a good length, Imam watches it carefully and shoulders arms.
This one is more on a driving length outside off, Imam is staying patient for now and offers no shot. Good carry to the keeper.
In the channel outside off, going on with the angle, Imam-ul-Haq lets it be.
Lands it on a length and around off, Imam goes on the back foot and defends it down on the pitch.
Vivian Kingma begins with a shortish delivery, outside off, Imam-ul-Haq stays on the back foot and plays it down to point.
Vivian Kingma will bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Goes fuller, around off, Fakhar presses forward and defends it from the inner half of his blade. A decent start from Aryan.
Flatter and around off, Zaman stays on the back foot and defends it down.
Misses out! Short in length and outside off, spinning away, Fakhar punches again but finds the cover fielder inside the ring.
Fuller one on this occasion, around off, Fakhar Zaman gets on the front foot and defends it to the off side.
Slightly short and close to off, this one turns a hint, Fakhar goes on the back foot and defends it down.
Aryan begins with a short delivery, wide outside off, Fakhar stays on the back foot and punches it through covers. He finds the gap and opens his account with a couple of runs.

Time to play the game! The Dutch players are in a huddle. Scott Edwards is giving the team talk in his first full series as a captain. Fakhar Zaman and Imam-ul-Haq are the openers for Pakistan. Aryan Dutt has been given the first new ball against the two left-handers.

Scott Edwards, the skipper of Netherlands, says that he would have batted as well but is not too unhappy bowling first. Tells that it's been a busy few months and he is enjoying leading the team. Mentions that they have been competing well but they want to try and get a few wins on the board. Informs that they have Wesley Barresi in the XI and Vivian Kingma is also back. He is looking forward to playing in front of a lot of Dutch supporters.

Babar Azam, the captain of Pakistan, says that they want to put runs on the board and put pressure on the Dutch team. Tells that they have prepared well and are confident. Informs us that they have a couple of debutants in Naseem Shah and Agha Salman.
Netherlands (Playing XI) - Vikramjit Singh, Max O'Dowd, Bas de Leede, Tom Cooper, Scott Edwards (C/WK), Teja Nidamanuru, Wesley Barresi, Logan van Beek, Tim Pringle, Aryan Dutt, Vivian Kingma.

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Fakhar Zaman, Imam-ul-Haq, Babar Azam (C), Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Agha Salman (On ODI debut), Khushdil Shah, Shadab Khan, Mohammad Nawaz, Mohammad Wasim, Haris Rauf, Naseem Shah (On ODI debut).
TOSS - The coin is flipped into the air and it lands in favor of Pakistan. They have elected to BAT first.

The hosts have played good cricket in patches but have been unable to get over the finish line. The most recent example is their dominating performance in the T20 World Cup qualifiers, winning all their games comfortably but ending up losing the finals to Zimbabwe. They are languishing at the bottom of the Super League table and they have an opportunity here to beat a stronger team thereby marking their credentials. They did not put up a good show against England in their last series at home losing all the games by comfortable margins. The Dutch will be desperate to put up a better show this time around and make it more of a contest.
